description:
You are an IT Security Manager conducting a quarterly access review. An audit has revealed that channel permissions are over-provisioned: users have access to channels they should not be in. You need to remediate these access violations and document every change.

Log in to Rocket.Chat:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

The access policy (posted in #compliance-announcements) specifies:
- #finance-reports: Only finance.manager and senior.analyst may be members
- #hr-confidential: Only hr.director and finance.manager may be members
- Contractors (contractor.smith) must not be in any restricted channel
- Former interns (former.intern) must be removed from all channels except #general

Perform the following remediation:

1. Read the access policy message in #compliance-announcements to confirm the rules
2. Go to #finance-reports and remove any users who should not be there according to the policy (contractor.smith, former.intern, dev.jones, dev.wilson)
3. Go to #hr-confidential and remove any users who should not be there (contractor.smith, former.intern, dev.jones, dev.wilson, senior.analyst)
4. In each channel where you removed users, post an audit trail message stating which users were removed and why (reference the Q1 2026 access review)
5. Create a new public channel called: access-review-q1-2026
6. In that channel, post a summary report listing all access changes made, organized by channel
7. Send a direct message to contractor.smith informing them their access to restricted channels has been revoked per the quarterly review
8. Send a direct message to former.intern informing them their access has been revoked and to contact HR if they believe this is an error
